messages:
Alex Chen: FYI the nightly model-refresh cron failed on prod bench run. Noticed CI saw a bunch of flaky throughput regressions. Logs attached below.
Jordan Patel: ugh, saw the alert. Can you paste the top error? link to job: https://ci.redwood/model-refresh/1711203456
Alex Chen: top error from daemon logs:
```
ERROR [2024-02-20T03:15:12Z] model-refresh: KV cache migration failed: failed to allocate 1289418240 bytes: out of memory
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/refresh/runner.py", line 312, in run_migration
    allocate_kv_cache(size)
MemoryError
```
Samir Gupta: thanks. That looks like OOM while expanding kv cache after dataset refresh. We pushed a larger tokenizer/data config yesterday (commit b7a3f2). Could be sequence length distribution changed.
Morgan Li: also seeing bench test `bench/throughput_test.py::test_inference_stability` failing intermittently in the nightly. Failure mode matches small mem headroom + big batch spikes.
Jordan Patel: can someone rerun the job with reduced KV size? I can kick off a manual run if needed.
sre-bot: I triggered a rerun of job `model-refresh/nightly/1711203456` on staging with env VARS: KV_MAX_BYTES=800000000. (run id: r-20240220-01)
Samir Gupta: nice. If staging is green we should add a guard to skip KV migration when host memory < 1.5GB free. That'll avoid breaking the whole bench pipeline.
Alex Chen: agreed. For immediate mitigation I'll add a short-term fix: change default KV allocation to min(config, 800MB) and open a follow-up ticket.
Jordan Patel: can you do a quick bisect to confirm which commit increased seq len distribution? Use this command: `./scripts/ci-bisect --range b7a3f2..HEAD --test bench/throughput_test.py::test_inference_stability`
If bisect points to the tokenizer change we can revert/patch.
Samir Gupta: starting bisect now, will report back in ~20m. If anyone sees other red tests, drop them here.
Morgan Li: adding temporary rule in the benchmark pipeline to skip the heavy model-refresh step on low-memory runners. Not ideal but buys time.
Alex Chen: created ticket INF-4123 to implement memory guard + alerting for KV migrations. Linking runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/model-refresh
Plan: 1) confirm bisect -> culprit, 2) revert/patch tokenizer if needed, 3) prod deploy config change, 4) longer-term memory-aware allocator.
Jordan Patel: ping me when bisect completes, I'll watch the staging rerun. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Samir Gupta: bisect result: tokenizer commit `b7a3f2` indeed increased median seq len ~1.6x. I pushed a patch to cap seq len during migration. Staging bench is green now (r-20240220-01 all checks pass).
Alex Chen: cool — promoting patch to canary and scheduling prod deploy tomorrow morning. Leaving this thread open for any follow-ups.
